public_rationale: The reviewed reports document abandoned negotiations and financing strain, but do not establish both events under the stated rule. Abilene development continued with a Microsoft announcement, while the Project Jupiter report concerns difficulty distributing loans already arranged. These records could support a looser reading of 'begin to fall apart,' but do not establish definitive debt-package failure. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: A broader interpretation of financing breakdown could change the assessment.
Some reporting relies on unnamed sources and earlier reporting rather than public loan documents.
Continuing projects do not disprove an undated forecast of failures elsewhere.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Data centers will eventually go unbuilt and data center debt packages will begin to fall apart.

statement.excerpt: Eventually, data centers are going to go unbuilt, and data center debt packages will begin to fall apart.

from_speaker: data centers are going to go unbuilt
data center debt packages will begin to fall apart
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns planned AI data centers and associated project financing discussed in the post.
Both construction abandonment and debt-package failure must occur after publication, though they need not concern the same project.
Going unbuilt means an identified planned project is abandoned, not merely delayed or transferred to another tenant.
A debt package falling apart means a planned package fails, is withdrawn or unwinds. Discounted debt trading or difficult syndication alone does not establish that event.
This is an event forecast, not a numerical claim about any company's debt balance.
criteria.support_condition: Dated post-publication records establish an abandoned planned AI data-center project and a failed or unwound data-center debt package.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period without such events contradicts this undated forecast. Successful individual projects or financings do not disprove it.

evidence.explanation: Reuters reports abandoned Abilene expansion negotiations, citing Bloomberg, but also reports continuing capacity plans and possible replacement tenancy. This does not establish both a permanently unbuilt project and a failed debt package.

evidence.explanation: Crusoe announces additional Abilene development for Microsoft and reports site preparation underway. This cautions against treating the earlier customer negotiations as proof that the planned physical development would remain unbuilt.

evidence.locator: Paragraph following the Oracle credit-rating discussion
evidence.explanation: The report describes stalled distribution and discounted quotes for loans already secured for Project Jupiter. That is evidence of financing strain, but does not establish withdrawal or unwinding of the project debt; no primary lender record was available in the reviewed material.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated records establishing an abandoned planned AI data center and a failed, withdrawn or unwound data-center debt package after publication. The same project may satisfy both requirements.
